data.name: Humza
data.gender_notes: Humza is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Humza is derived from the name of a renowned companion of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH), known for his bravery and steadfastness. The name Humza carries the meaning “Steadfast and Resolute” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Humza usually hope their child will grow to embody steadfast and resolute and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Humza is associated with courage, strength, and unwavering commitment to faith.
data.etymology: Humza belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Steadfast and Resolute.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Humza total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: The name Humza holds a significant cultural impact in the Muslim world, as it is associated with the bravery and heroism of one of the most revered figures in Islamic history, Humza bin Zaid ibn Awfa. Humza was a prominent companion of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH), and is known for his unwavering courage and bravery during several battles and military expeditions. The name is a reminder of the values of loyalty, bravery, and steadfastness that have been integral to Muslim history and civilization.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Humza holds great significance as it is derived from the name of a noble companion of the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH), who embodied the qualities of faith, courage, and unwavering devotion to the teachings of Islam. The name is a constant reminder of the virtues that Muslims should strive to cultivate in their lives, including patience, resilience, and unwavering faith in Allah. The spiritual significance of the name Humza is an inspiration for Muslims to live their lives in accordance with the teachings of their faith, and to demonstrate the same level of courage and steadfastness in the face of adversity.
